Tuesday, June 16, 2026 | 6:30 PM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX000001ACSL2A4/
Celebrate the start of summer with ice cream and friends at the Worcester + Narragansett social on Tuesday, June 16! We'll be at West End Creamery in Whitinsville, MA starting at 6:30pm. Come whenever you can (West End is open until 9pm)! West End has lots of delicious ice cream options, including dairy and gluten free. Enjoy ice cream, meet like-minded outdoor enthusiasts, meet Worcester and Narragansett 20s & 30s leaders, and learn about activities you can do with AMC this summer. We look forward to seeing everyone, new and returning participants, for a fun night!We are a group within AMC that is dedicated to encouraging people in their 20s and 30s to enjoy the outdoors.

Friday, June 19, 2026 | 7:00 PM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX0000018YtZ2AU/
TRAIL CULT PRESENTS...The Jackalope Society cordially invites you to our Summer Formal. Huzzah.For generations uncounted (and several likely not-yet-invented) the Jackalope Society has convened / will convene twice annually to uphold the sacred principles of merriment, mystery, and the honorable pursuit of becoming the strange thing glimpsed in the woods. As the AMC's premiere, publicly-open secret order, it is the Jackalope Society's privilege to welcome the various 20s & 30s members of our community to gather and ponder the overlap of the outdoors and the weird.Attendance at this gathering shall entitle the bearer to an evening of:Unlicensed revelryThe democratic development of curious rites of questionable originPageantry and ceremonial nonsenseBootleg awards and unforeseen rewardsAttire is to be interpreted broadly, but "formal" is the preferred means of garb. What does "formal" mean? Well, by "formal" (and we are heavily applying air quotes) we mean whatever it is you care to mean. This includes but is not limited to: suits only worn during job interviews, bridesmaid dresses banished to the backs of closets, kilts dubiously purchased at renaissance festivals, Canadian tuxedos, a tie worn over the sports jersey you slept in, etc. "Formal" (air quotes still included) is a state of mind, not dress. Crushed velvet, capes, amulets, and other inexplicable accessories are of course always appreciated as well.The Jackalope Society Summer Formal will be held at the Northborough Historical Society (52 Main St, Northborough, MA 01532) from 7:00pm - 9:00pm on June 19th. We are charging a $5 fee to provide snack-atizers. A full meal will not be provided, please arrive having dined. Beverages are of the bring-your-own variety. Bringing a dish to share is also appreciated, but certainly not required. If the $5 contribution to the hors d'œuvre fund is unmanageable, attendance is still welcome and encouraged.With these summons, consider yourself duly invited. May the moon favor your passage, the forest decline to remember your name, and your RSVP be both joyous and affirmative.This social is intended as a space for the 20s & 30s affinity to group to laugh, goof-off, and appreciate a nonsensical good-time. If you are not a member of the 20s & 30s affinity group, please consider a different activity.

events.summary: Worcester 20s & 30s 2nd Annual Hostel Takeover Weekend in the White Mountains

description.plain:
Friday, June 26, 2026 | 8:00 PM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX00000152yH2AQ/
Join the Worcester Chapter 20s & 30s for a weekend of outdoor fun in the White Mountains June 26-29 for the second annual Hostel Takeover! This year’s theme is…aliens! Expect the theme to crop up throughout the trip; participation in it is optional!The trip runs from the evening of Friday, June 26 through Monday, June 29. A variety of hiking and socializing opportunities will be offered each day as we explore several regions of the White Mountains. At least two hiking options, one moderate and one vigorous, will be provided each day (for rating definitions, go here). Specific offerings will be determined by leaders that weekend depending on participant ability and conditions. Hikes will be in the immediate area and possibly others farther afield. After the days’ hikes, we will all return to the Conway Hostel (CoHo), our basecamp for the weekend. The trip includes three nights’ lodging at CoHo, where you will find all the comforts you are looking for after a long hike– shared bunk rooms, private bathrooms, a shared kitchen with full access, and shared space for socializing. A group dinner will be included and served on Saturday and Sunday evening, and CoHo offers free coffee, tea, and granola bars for breakfasts. Friday night dinner will be an optional potluck. Breakfast (other than what the hostel offers) and lunches not included. Evening activities will be offered, possibilities including a movie screening, star gazing, fire pit, and games. The hostel is also a ~5 minute walk away from the Saco River where swimming is allowed.Cost is $170 for AMC members ($185 for non-members) per person for 3 nights at CoHo and 2 dinners. If the cost of this trip is an obstacle for you being able to attend, please reach out to Jake at jjscoggin@gmail.com, as we have limited subsidy options available. Refunds are not guaranteed and are dependent on someone taking your spot if this event reaches full capacity. Once you register for the trip here, one of the leaders will send a screening form to gather further information to ensure the trip will be safe and fun for all participants. Payment will be collected once your spot on the trip has been confirmed.Gear is available for loan through the Worcester Chapter Gear Shed for those who may need it. No dogs, please.As an affinity group within AMC that is dedicated to encouraging people in their 20s and 30s to enjoy the outdoors, this is a trip for those in their 20s and 30s.
